description: ACF PreToolUse approval prompt (forces a permission prompt around approval, in every repository whatever .acf/enabled says; fails closed), SubagentStart constraint injection and PostToolUse Tier-1 gate (exit 2 on BLOCK findings and on gate failures; host detectors need an approval through acf-approve). Requires `python` on PATH with the acf package installed; the SubagentStart and PostToolUse hooks no-op until the host has `.acf/enabled` (written by /acf-setup).
